programme.title: Pure Hunting
programme.desc: Archery elk hunting is Willi’s biggest passion and Montana is one of his favorite states to do it in. He already had success with his bow in Utah, taking his best bull to date. He is excited to try an area of Montana he has’t hunted, but he scouted earlier in the year.

programme.title: Big Buck Blueprint
programme.desc: n this episode, we sit down with 19-year-old Jared Wurth to break down the story behind one of the biggest hard-horned whitetails to hit the dirt this past season. This wasn’t just a big deer — it was a 241 5/8” GIANT, officially scored by Buckmasters. And what makes it even crazier? It all happened on just 40 acres, from a tree his dad planted 25 years ago. A quarter century of growth. Years of patience. One moment that changed everything. Jared walks us through the history of the property, how this buck survived and matured, the strategy behind the setup, and what it felt like when a true once-in-a-lifetime whitetail stepped into range. Huge congrats again to Jared on an absolute Ohio giant. You’re not going to want to miss this one.

When a city socialite inherits a sprawling ranch, she plans to sell it off—until Roy and the Sons of the Pioneers step in to show her the true value of life on the range. With scheming villains, sweeping landscapes, and plenty of toe-tapping tunes, this Roy Rogers classic proves that the West is as rich in heart as it is in land.

When outlaw Billy the Kid (Jack Buetel) rides into town, he finds himself entangled in a volatile triangle with legendary gunslinger Doc Holliday (Walter Huston) and ruthless lawman Pat Garrett (Thomas Mitchell). But it’s the fiery beauty Rio McDonald (Jane Russell, in her breakout role) who stirs the deadliest conflict of all. A tale of guns, desire, and betrayal, The Outlaw blazes with the daring spirit that made it one of Hollywood’s most talked-about films.

This film immerses you in the timeless beauty of the Welsh countryside, from mist-covered mountains to lush green valleys dotted with grazing sheep. programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Marathon in the Florida Keys is home to some of the most unique fishing in the world, and on this episode of Local Knowledge we’re experiencing it with one of the area’s most respected captains. Rush Maltz reunites with his longtime friend, Captain Jeff Rella of Superfish Charters, to explore the deep drop fishery of the middle keys and Marathon. Together they target awesome species including queen snapper, barrel-fish, snowy grouper, and tilefish. After action-packed day offshore, we unwind at the world-famous Hawks Cay Resort, one of the Florida Keys’ premier destinations for anglers, families, and anyone looking to experience island life at its best.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: In this episode, Rush welcomes Cullen Lundholm from Cape Cod to experience Key West at its finest. Over several action-packed days, they target a variety of species in the incredible waters surrounding the Florida Keys. But the adventure doesn’t end at the dock—Cullen also experiences Key West’s world-class accommodations, exceptional food, and one-of-a-kind island lifestyle. From unforgettable fishing to first-class hospitality, this episode shows why Key West and the Florida Keys are among the world’s premier fishing and vacation destinations.
